name: Acererak and Eye of Vecna
tactics: Fate of Drained Souls When a victim of drain soul fails its second saving throw, the victim’s soul is trapped in one of the attacking creature’s soul gems. The soul’s former body crumbles into dust at the end of the creature’s next turn, and the soul is in danger of being expended, which destroys it. As long as a target’s soul remains intact within a gem, the gem glows with a faint inner light and reveals an image of a tiny figure inside. This gem can be used as part of a Raise Dead ritual, reducing the component cost by half. A victim whose soul is destroyed can still be brought back by a Raise Dead ritual.

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Four individual Tiny creatures can fit in a square, and a Tiny creature can enter a larger creature’s space and end its turn there. Having a reach of 0 means a Tiny creature cannot make melee attacks against targets outside its own space, unless otherwise noted.

traits.name: Intruding Terror
traits.details: Enemies within the aura take a -2 penalty to attack rolls.

traits.name: Deathless Accuracy
traits.details: While bloodied, Acererak gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls, and he can score a critical hit on a roll of 18–20.

traits.name: Deathless Resistance
traits.details: At the start of his turn, Acererak makes a saving throw against one effect of his choice that a save can end. In addition, Acererak is immune to being slowed, immobilized, or knocked prone.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.details: Acererak regains 30 hit points whenever he starts his turn and has at least 1 hit point. If Acererak takes radiant damage, his regeneration doesn’t function until the end of his next turn.

traits.name: Soul Gems
traits.details: Acererak normally has eight soul gems, but he has replaced one with the Eye of Vecna and currently has only seven, each of which can hold the soul of one of his victims. At the start of an encounter, three of the soul gems contain souls. Crushing a gem after Acererak is defeated releases the soul to the Shadowfell.
